headline: Integrating technical precision, professional discipline, and strategic inclusion in every collaboration.
about: Blind entrepreneur and specialty coffee specialist with registered intellectual property, international performance credentials, and a decade of institutional training experience. Co-founder & Owner of [Bar Peteng Slow Coffee Bar](https://instagram.com/barpeteng) and the first certified blind barista in Indonesia to complete an internationally standardized curriculum without modification. Based in Leeds, UK — open for collaboration, consulting, and professional engagements.

branding.footer_name: Mang Aduy – Co-Founder of Bar Peteng | Professional Barista | Creative Entrepreneur & Accessibility Consultant

items.title: Brewing & Serving Coffee - Spring Nexus 2026
items.desc: One day brewing and serving specialty coffee beans as a professional barista in Spring Nexus 2026, an interactive networking session held by [Doctrine UK](https://instagram.com/doctrine.uk) x [Curdis Leeds](https://instagram.com/curdis.leeds) in the [University of Leeds](https://instagram.com/universityofleeds).

items.title: YouTube Content Creator – Traveling & Accessible Technology Review
items.desc: Producing video content documenting travel experiences and evaluating gadgets and technology from the perspective of a blind professional. Reviews cover both accessible and non-accessible products, including practical workarounds to maximize usability for blind and visually impaired users in daily life and professional settings.

items.title: Founder & Registered Intellectual Property/HKI Owner – "Pouring in the Dark"
items.desc:
Intellectual Property registered for the blind sensory experience and intimate coffee blind tasting methodology which mix between inclusive education and premium coffee experience, under the name of Achmad Yudha Rachmatullah, the legal name of Mang Aduy.

Successfully trialed at [Mini Kopi](https://instagram.com/minikopi.greenville), Jakarta, Indonesia (2023) collaborated with [Juno The Coffee Company](https://instagram.com/juno_thecoffeecompany) & [Abeza Coffee Supply](https://instagram.com/abezacoffeesupply).

Officially launched with multiple sold-out sessions at [Bar Peteng Slow Coffee Bar](https://instagram.com/barpeteng) Indonesia (Sept-Oct 2025), collaborated with [Sakha Coffee Roastery](https://instagram.com/sakhacoffeeroastery).

items.title: Professional Guest Barista – Toko Kopi Tjaraka, Jakarta, Indonesia
items.desc: One day bar take over serving specialty coffee beans using manual brew method directly to the customer.

items.title: Professional Guest Barista – Toko Kopi Lajeng, Bandung, Indonesia
items.desc: Three days bar take over serving specialty coffee beans using manual brew method directly to the customer.

items.title: The Silent Brewing Project: 500+ Episodes Content Production
items.desc:
Daily audio and visual (ASMR) documented coffee brewing that portrays meticulous technical discipline and consistency in Instagram [@mang.aduy](https://instagram.com/mang.aduy) and TikTok [@mng.aduy](https://tiktok.com/mng.aduy).

This project aims at organically educating audience on the precise manual brewing technique as well as a testimony to the ability of blind barista adhering to the professional standard coffee industry.

items.title: Co-founder & Owner – Bar Peteng Slow Coffee Bar, Indonesia
items.desc:
Orchestrated the end-to-end management, system planning, and menu development for a customized slow coffee bar.
Operating with full autonomy as the head barista, ensuring technical perfection and consistent quality in every service.

items.title: Co-founder – Kopi Djamoe Mertjon (KJM) Mang Aduy, Indonesia
items.desc: Developing and overseeing F&B business unit focusing on unique menu.

items.title: Co-founder – Mang Aduy Laundromat, Indonesia
items.desc: Responsible for the retail operational and management, customer service strategy, and business continuity plan.

items.title: Co-founder, CTO and System Developer kabardifabel.com
items.desc: Developing and leading website-based information platform on disability issues.

items.title: Infrastructure Auditor: Indonesian High-Speed Rail WHOOSH - Team Member of Jakarta Barrier Free Tourism
items.desc: Technical accessibility audit for the railway station, the car design, and the train crew understanding on accessibility and disability support.

items.title: Corporate Accessibility Consultant: CBM Global Disability Inclusion Indonesia Office - Team Member of Jakarta Barrier Free Tourism
items.desc: Strategic consulting service through accessibility audit on the building and facilities, surrounding area, social media, and CBM website.

items.title: Trainer – Disabled People Information and Technology Workshops held by Indonesian Ministry of Information and Communication/Kominfo (today known as Komdigi)
items.desc: Instructor on the national empowerment program for disabled people on digital strategy which includes digital marketing, social media for business, e-commerce management, and copywrighting.

items.title: Trainer – Internet Marketing for Disabled Teacher in Special School held by Centre for Development and Empowerment for Educators and Teachers of Kindergarten (Nursery School) and Special School (P4TKTK dan PLB) and Kerta Mentas Mandiri Foundation
items.desc: Instructor on digital marketing workshops for disabled teachers of special school in Jakarta and Bandung for them to transfer the knowledge and skill to their students so they can independently improve their economic level.

items.title: Trainer – Digital Marketing held by Indonesian Braille Publishing House (BPBI Abiyoso)
items.desc: Digital marketing workshops for blind people for 3 days focused on copywriting, e-commerce management and optimalisation, and Google My Business (GMB) management and optimalisation, aims at improving the participants ability to sell products or services via internet for a wider market.

items.title: Trainer – Radio streaming held by Indonesian Braille Publishing House (BPBI Abiyoso)
items.desc: Professional Radio Streaming workshops for blind people for 3 days on broadcasting basic knowledge, radio streaming software and hardware introduction, accessible software and hardware setup, and live streaming trial.

items.title: Trainer – Digital Education held by Indonesian Braille Publishing House (BPBI Abiyoso)
items.desc: Basic Computer Training for blind people in 3 locations: Garut, Ciamis, and Majalengka (each for 3 days), which covered accessing MS Office and internet, file managing, basic screen reader that they can use to pursue further education or to work.

items.title: The 1st and only Blind Participant of Tarung Tiga Competition at Jakarta Coffee Week (JaCoWeek), Indonesia
items.desc:
A two-time competitor in Tarung Tiga Competition as part of the Jakarta Coffee Week (Jacoweek), the largest coffee event in South-East Asia.
The one and only blind participant of Tarung Tiga Competition since it was being held for the first time.

items.title: Barista Certified by the ABCD School of Coffee Indonesia (Cohort 612)
items.desc:
Trained under the curriculum of [Hendri Kurniawan](https://instagram.com/thephatuncle) (WBC Certified Judge), mastering international standards in sensory analysis and brewing mechanics without modifications or special adjustments.
Distinguished as the first and only visually impaired individual in Indonesia to successfully complete this standardized professional coffee curriculum and earn certification from a formal coffee school.

items.title: Shiatsu Therapist Certified by the Wyata Guna Rehabilitation Centre Bandung, Indonesia
items.desc: Participated in and completed the Shiatsu Therapy Training in the Wyata Guna Rehabilitation Centre Bandung, Indonesia for 2 years.

items.title: Clinical Shiatsu Therapist at Klinik Wyna Shiatsu Bandung, Indonesia
items.desc: Practicing professional shiatsu therapy after graduated from Shiatsu Therapy Formal Education in Wyata Guna Rehabilitation Centre in Bandung, Indonesia for 2 years.

items.title: International Guest Performer at Thailand 2nd Blind Music Festival in Chiang Mai
items.desc: Representative of Indonesian Musician Delegation in Thailand International Music Festival in Chiang Mai, Thailand held by Thailand Association of the Blind (TAB).

items.title: International Guest Performer at Thailand 2nd Blind Music Festival in Bangkok
items.desc: Representative of Indonesian Musician Delegation in Thailand International Music Festival in Bangkok, Thailand held by Thailand Association of the Blind (TAB).

items.title: Professional Bassist & Performer
items.desc: Regular bassist player ([The Valley Bistro Cafe](https://instagram.com/thevalleybistrocafe), [The Peak Resort & Dining](https://instagram.com/thepeakresortdining), Bandung International School, etc.
